Candidates were pooled by eval/build_gold_candidates.py from five independent sources; grades follow the per-question criteria in data/gold/search_spec.json. Papers outside the pool are treated as not relevant.
status: reviewed — grades proposed by Claude from the ORKG records, reviewed and approved by the author on 2026-10-16

grading.2: Directly relevant: the paper's ORKG record (title or contributions) contains what the question asks for — e.g. both compared methods, the claimed result, the dataset in use, the exact paper.
grading.1: Partially relevant: on topic and useful as context, but misses part of the question (e.g. only one of two compared methods, right method but different task).
grading.0: Not relevant: lexical match only (e.g. 'A-CNN' for CNN), different topic, or no usable information.
